description: Land Title Settlement Department - Liyandeniya, Doluwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320024 (23/0800)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Land Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and property details. The content is entirely focused on land ownership and title settlement, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title matters without any government personnel changes or structural administrative modifications.
